notes.subject: וינחם
notes.rationale: Read as 'leads them away (into exile)' (JPS/ASV) vs 'straitens/quiets them' (KJV/ילת) — from נוח rather than נחה.

notes.subject: לגוים ... לגוים
notes.rationale: Parallel repetition of 'the nations' frames the rise-and-fall chiasm, kept by repeating 'ol lain'.

translation: Em i mekim ol lain bilong ol man i kamap bikpela, na em i bagarapim ol; em i spetim ol lain aut, na em i tekim ol i go.

tokens.gloss: em i mekim ol i kamap bikpela
na em i tekim ol i go
